description: Sends Dusty's a request for a table on a given day and time, with the person's name, phone number and email address. The restaurant answers the person by email; the table is not confirmed until it does. The time must be one of the restaurant's table times for that day.

date.description: The day, as YYYY-MM-DD, on the restaurant clock (Europe/London).

email.description: The person's email address: the confirmation is sent there.

name.description: The person's name, for the booking.

notes.description: Anything the restaurant should know, e.g. a special request. Optional.

party_size.description: How many people, from 1 to 12. For more than 12, the person should call the restaurant.

phone.description: The person's phone number, so the restaurant can reach them.

time.description: The time, as HH:MM on the 24-hour restaurant clock, e.g. 18:30. One of the restaurant's table times for that day.

name: request_table_booking
title: Ask for a table
